explanation: This component is 0 everywhere except at D1 right after an unrewarded trial that ended in S2 (by either a common or a rare transition); it is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and 0 at D1 after rewarded trials or after unrewarded visits to S1. On those D1 steps it is usually 10 in the first ~40 trials, or when S2 has been failing and the agent is switching to a1; it drops to about 3-7 later in the episode, and to 0-3 if S2 was rewarded on the trials just before.
